description: Source file implementing binary operation preparation and optimization routines for PyTorch's onednn JIT fusion, including handling scalar promotion, type promotion, and fused add decomposition.

methods.name: compareConstValue
methods.description: Compares a constant value in a Value object to a double, considering integer and double types.

methods.name: handleBinaryOpInputs
methods.description: Handles scalar promotion and type promotion for binary operations with tensor and scalar inputs.

methods.name: ConvertScalarToTensor
methods.description: Recursively converts scalar inputs to tensors for binary operations in a block.

methods.name: mayDecomposeAdd
methods.description: Decomposes fused add operations with alpha parameter into separate multiply and add.

methods.name: DecomposeFusedAdd
methods.description: Recursively decomposes fused add nodes within a block.

methods.name: EliminateIdentityMulAdd
methods.description: Eliminates identity multiply and add nodes (multiplying by 1 or adding 0).

methods.name: PrepareBinaryForLLGA
methods.description: Main function to prepare a graph for LLGA by decomposing adds, eliminating identities, and converting scalars.
